actionContract.safeEdits: Only keyword quick-fix TextEdit actions may be applied. The test uses the returned TextEdit span and replacement.
actionContract.unsafeEdits: Missing expressions, missing separators, and missing aliases have no test-authored replacement because syntax alone cannot infer user intent.
actionContract.keywordSuggestionGuard: Non-word pseudo-keywords and identifier labels immediately before ':' must not receive a keyword TextEdit.
actionContract.reparse: Every safe emitted edit must produce the exact registered repaired query and parse without diagnostics.
actionContract.boundary: The diagnostic span must end at or before the registered next clause token; no case may consume that token.
actionContract.literalsAndTrivia: Comments, CRLF trivia, bracketed identifiers, and literal text must remain in the repaired document.
